objective: Computation: P1 and P2 on every census stage to 40 junctions and on UNIQUE-TABLE rivals; every legal meet-once arrangement of at most 7 junctions, tables, collisions, states, and whether any other-states collision has both sides satisfying P1.
status: Refuted 2026-11-19 (referee pending; census last shard pending): backed pairs with meeting once do not make the table carry the states: among 503,039 legal meet-once arrangements of at most 7 junctions, 472 table groups have other states, 242 of their pairs with both sides backed (S1a failed) and 38 with both of peel depth >= 1 (S1b failed); none with both of depth >= 2 (S1c held, 77 such arrangements) and none with both self-grown (exploratory, 85). C1 and C2 held on 70,228 census stages; R1 failed (178 of 1,099 open meet-once reached tables have a symmetry the states lack); S0 held.
title: The parent rule on the census, the rivals and every small arrangement
